item.title: Unlocking the Energy Potential of Lithium: From Rechargeable Batteries to Future Nuclear Technologies
item.description:

Energy & Environmental Science | 💭 Perspective
💡 The novelty lies in bridging lithium's established role in electrochemical energy storage with its emerging potential in nuclear technologies, expanding the element's energy applications beyond batteries. Its significance is in proposing a unified perspective on lithium as a versatile energy carrier, potentially guiding future research and technology development across both rechargeable battery systems and nuclear energy, thereby reshaping global energy strategies.

item.title: Regulating the Spin-State and Frontier Orbital of a Molecular FePc Catalyst by Interlayer Electronic Coupling for Enhanced ORR Activity
item.description:
کوپلاژ الکترونیکی بین‌لایه‌ای در FePc@CoNC اسپین و اوربیتال‌های مرزی Fe را تنظیم کرده و فعالیت ORR را با پتانسیل نیم‌موج 0.927 V بهبود می‌دهد.
Nano Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using interlayer electronic coupling with adjacent Co single atoms and nanoparticles to tune FePc's spin state and frontier orbitals. This suppresses Fe 3d spin polarization and enhances dz2 electron localization, optimizing intermediate adsorption. The strategy yields high ORR activity (0.927 V half-wave potential, 336 mW cm–2 peak power) and durability, offering a general approach for engineering molecular Fe–N4 electrocatalysts.
🏷 oxygen reduction reaction · FePc catalyst · interlayer electronic coupling · spin-state regulation · zinc-air battery
